Though our bodies had probably not moved even one step from the start. Not one step of travel, and still I was relieved to be back.

Whatever the case, we were safe. My self was still in my own possession. The silver-white had gone out of Muramasa's armor also.

And...

en.html:
Now that she said it, the shape did seem different.
Where was the difference? How was it different? Haan, those were very good questions, and I could not have pointed to an answer.

Still, I had noticed it. After she told me. This was nearly the same as noticing it myself, except for the noticing. Ask me to identify the changed part and the investigation would suffer, so best not to become overambitious. Somewhere on this sword there was possibly a difference. I had narrowed it down to the entire sword. Another man might have included the surrounding countryside.
en.text:
Now that she said it, the shape did seem different.
Where was the difference? How was it different? Haan, those were very good questions, and I could not have pointed to an answer.

Still, I had noticed it. After she told me. This was nearly the same as noticing it myself, except for the noticing. Ask me to identify the changed part and the investigation would suffer, so best not to become overambitious. Somewhere on this sword there was possibly a difference. I had narrowed it down to the entire sword. Another man might have included the surrounding countryside.

I took the nodachi in my hand and followed its crescent-shaped blade with my eyes.

A simple temper pattern, like beads on a string. Why it should bring someone's face to mind, I could not say.
